about: A 华住 结账单 (桔子 brand, Apache FOP PDF) whose text layer prints each label alone and its full-width colon and value as one run beside it (`入住日期` then `： 2026-08-11`). The value kept its colon, so both dates were missing and 房间号 read `：8513` (#447). 客人姓名 and 付款合计 are not labels this 版式 reads. Captured from the real PDF; guest name, 确认码 and the hotel phone number redacted.

facts.hotelName: 桔子北京通州宋庄安贞医院酒店
